transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I can help answer questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright, or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks again!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 5 by stating, "It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses." However, the agent did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice` at any point in the conversation. The agent was interrupted after delivering only the first part of the expected response to the patient's question about light sensitivity.
